motions.motion_text: MOTION TO ADJOURN FROM THE BOULDER CITY COUNCIL AND CONVENE AS THE GENERAL CANVASSING AND ELECTION BOARD FOR THE CITY OF BOULDER GENERAL COORDINATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION.
MOTION NOMINATING A MEMBER TO CHAIR THE BOARD.
MOTION THAT THE ABSTRACT AND RESULT SHEETS BE APPROVED, AND SIGNING OF SAME IF APPROVED.
MOTION TO ADJOURN FROM THE GENERAL CANVASSING AND ELECTION BOARD FOR THE GENERAL COORDINATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION AND RECONVENE AS THE BOULDER CITY COUNCIL.
motions.vote_text: Seeing no objection the motion was approved by acclamation.

motions.motion_text: MOTION TO APPROVE CONSENT ITEMS 3A THROUGH 3F.
MOTION TO APPOINT AN EXTERNAL FINANCIAL EXPERT TO THE COUNCIL AUDIT COMMITTEE.

open_comment_speakers.name: Joe Pezzillo
open_comment_speakers.topic: Acknowledged success of the March 8th election, then requested that hand counting be considered for future elections.

open_comment_speakers.name: Neal McBurnett
open_comment_speakers.topic: Urged support for SB 198 which would require paper audits and suggested different methods for hand count audits.

open_comment_speakers.name: Tim Thomas
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke to council goals, acknowledging laudible goals but raising new issues regarding plurality, ethics, transparency, and majority rules.

open_comment_speakers.name: Erin Hamby
open_comment_speakers.topic: Requested that the City of Boulder consider adoption of the Mayor’s for Peace – 2020 Vision resolution.

open_comment_speakers.name: Mary Louise Chavers
open_comment_speakers.topic: Thanked City Manager Bruno for consideration of protecting the Prairie Dogs.

open_comment_speakers.name: Dan Sukle
open_comment_speakers.topic: Opposed to the number of increased 'no dog' trails proposed by the OSMP Board in the Open Space Visitor Plan.

open_comment_speakers.name: Robin Beeck
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke to the First Annual Boulder International Film Festival, noting its success and educational benefits.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lori Fuller
open_comment_speakers.topic: Indicated that Council would soon receive a report from FIDO’s regarding sight and voice control on trails.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rob Smoke
open_comment_speakers.topic: Encouraged Council to carefully consider a movement to allow people to party responsibly.

open_comment_speakers.name: Alan Rudy
open_comment_speakers.topic: Expressed concern that Prairie dogs may destroy the beautiful Parks and Open Space.

open_comment_speakers.name: Chris Morrison
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke in support of sight and voice control of dogs on trails in HCA areas of Open Space.

open_comment_speakers.name: Len Haule
open_comment_speakers.topic: Noted that volunteers doing local productions often have to supply their own tapes.

open_comment_speakers.name: Jann Scott
open_comment_speakers.topic: Addressed funding numbers and distributed save channel 54 stickers.

open_comment_speakers.name: Bill Flinchbaugh
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke of important services provided by CATV and urged continued funding.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rob Smoke
open_comment_speakers.topic: Urged continued funding and inquired about pass along funding.

open_comment_speakers.name: Peter Gowen
open_comment_speakers.topic: Supported the study group proposal.

open_comment_speakers.name: Brett Parnes
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke in support of returning PEG funds to CATV and consolidation of channels.

open_comment_speakers.name: Guy Errickson
open_comment_speakers.topic: Urged Council to cease funding for Channel 54.

open_comment_speakers.name: Donna Marek
open_comment_speakers.topic: Does not support current model of Public Access as it functions as a private club.

open_comment_speakers.name: Dan Culberson
open_comment_speakers.topic: Indicated that if the original funding mechanism was restored, this discussion wouldn't be needed.

open_comment_speakers.name: Nathaniel Kramer
open_comment_speakers.topic: Urged support for Channel 54.

open_comment_speakers.name: Howard Zaemba
open_comment_speakers.topic: Urged return of PEG funds to CATV.

open_comment_speakers.name: Aaron Smith
open_comment_speakers.topic: Urged support for Channel 54, noting value for High School students.

open_comment_speakers.name: Eron Brennan
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke in support of Public Access television.

open_comment_speakers.name: Steve Clason
open_comment_speakers.topic: On behalf of Martin Acres supports ACLU.

open_comment_speakers.name: Barry Satlow
open_comment_speakers.topic: Representing ACLU – supports current proposal.

open_comment_speakers.name: Neil Fishman
open_comment_speakers.topic: Opposed current proposal and supports staff/HRC proposal for domestic partnership rights.

open_comment_speakers.name: Terry Cipoletti
open_comment_speakers.topic: Supports full equality for all people and opening to mixed couples.

open_comment_speakers.name: Michael Mills
open_comment_speakers.topic: Strongly opposed to the amendment limiting occupancy rights to same sex couples.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lisa Spalding
open_comment_speakers.topic: Supports current ordinance limiting occupancy rights to same sex couples only.

open_comment_speakers.name: Jill McFadden
open_comment_speakers.topic: Supports opening the ordinance occupancy privilege to all domestic partners.

open_comment_speakers.name: Matt Patrick
open_comment_speakers.topic: Clarified that the issue came to HRC in 2002 and echoed concerns regarding gay marriage.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: MOTION TO ADJOURN FROM THE BOULDER CITY COUNCIL AND CONVENE AS THE GENERAL CANVASSING AND ELECTION BOARD FOR THE CITY OF BOULDER GENERAL COORDINATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion to adjourn and convene as the General Canvassing and Election Board carried 8:0.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: ROLL CALL OF THE GENERAL CANVASSING AND ELECTION BOARD.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: All members were present.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: ADMINISTRATION OF OATH AND SIGNING OF SAME BY BOARD MEMBERS.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION NOMINATING A MEMBER TO CHAIR THE BOARD.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion to nominate Mayor Ruzzin to chair the Board carried 8:0.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: SUBMISSION TO THE BOARD BY THE SECRETARY OF THE FOLLOWING: I. CERTIFICATE OF THE OFFICIAL BALLOT. II. CERTIFICATES OF THE OFFICIAL PUBLIC NOTICES OF THE MARCH 8, 2005 ELECTION. III. CERTIFICATE OF ELECTION RETURNS.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARING

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION THAT THE ABSTRACT AND RESULT SHEETS BE APPROVED, AND SIGNING OF SAME IF APPROVED.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion to approve the abstract and result sheets carried 8:0.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: MOTION TO ADJOURN FROM THE GENERAL CANVASSING AND ELECTION BOARD FOR THE GENERAL COORDINATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION AND RECONVENE AS THE BOULDER CITY COUNCIL.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion to adjourn and reconvene as the Boulder City Council was approved by acclamation.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: SWEARING IN OF NEW COUNCILMEMBER.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Clerk Alisa Lewis swore in newly elected Councilmember Suzy Ageton.

agenda_items.title: AMERICAN PUBLIC WORKS ASSOCIATION AWARD PRESENTATION. – 6:30p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Dan Hartman presented the City of Boulder with 2 Public Works Awards.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE – 6:35p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Bruno provided updates on the Alcohol Issues Study Session and Prairie Dog monitoring.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA: - 7:23p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved consent items 3A through 3F with Councilmember Eldridge recused from item 3F.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM MARCH 1, 2005.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ACCEPT THE SUMMARY OF THE JANUARY 25, 2005 STUDY SESSION ON ORGANIZATIONAL REVIEW AND MANAGEMENT ANALYSIS OF THE CITY ATTORNEY’S OFFICE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ACCEPT THE SUMMARY FROM THE JANUARY 25, 2005, STUDY SESSION ON ADMISSIONS TAX.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER, OR HIS DESIGNEE, TO CONVEY THE PERMANENTLY AFFORDABLE HOUSING UNIT LOCATED AT 2610 IRIS, UNIT 105 TO AN ELIGIBLE BUYER.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF EMERGENCY ORDINANCE No. 7417 ADOPTING SUPPLEMENT No. 83, WHICH CODIFIES PREVIOUSLY ADOPTED ORDINANCE NOS. 7378, 7385, 7389, 7390, 7394, 7400, 7401, AND 7406, AS AN AMENDMENT TO THE BOULDER REVISED CODE 1981, AND SETTING FORTH DETAILS IN RELATION THERETO.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7415 AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE A DEED OF VACATION TO VACATE THE EASTERLY 12 FEET OF A 67.5 FOOT RIGHT-OF-WAY FOR 168 FEET OF SIXTH STREET, ADJACENT TO 605 CONCORD AVENUE. (LUR2003-00107).
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved.

agenda_items.title: CALL-UP CHECK IN: - 7:26p.m.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Attorney Calonne provided additional clarity regarding the Planning Board action on the Use Review for expansion of Illegal Pete’s.

agenda_items.title: REPORT FROM THE PEG ACCESS TELEVISION STUDY GROUP ABOUT CONTINUED OPERATION OF CHANNEL 54. – 7:30PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council concurred that the study group and CATV would need to present a different vision/model no later than August.

agenda_items.title: THIRD READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7416 AMENDING OCCUPANCY REGULATIONS BY AMENDING TITLE 12, “HUMAN RIGHTS” WITH THE ADDITION OF A NEW CHAPTER RELATED TO THE CREATION OF A DOMESTIC PARTNERSHIP REGISTRY, AMENDING THE DEFINITIONS RELATED TO A FAMILY THROUGHOUT THE BOULDER REVISED CODE 1981, MAKING CLARIFICATIONS RELATED TO OWNER OCCUPANCY REQUIREMENTS, AND SETTING FORTH DETAILS IN RELATION THERETO. – 9:10PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Ordinance No. 7416 as amended with fourth reading on the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: UPDATE ON THE VALMONT BUTTE PROPOSALS. – 10:02PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Planning Director Peter Pollock provided a timeline for upcoming events and noted that the CEAP process has been completed.

agenda_items.title: BOULDER TRANSIT VILLAGE UPDATE. – 10:06PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Bruno outlined a three phase approach for the Transit Village project.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: NONE

agenda_items.section: 8. MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL-UPS: - 10:10PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

THIS PROPERTY IS ZONED BUSINESS MAIN STREET-REDEVELOPING (BMS-X). WIP DATE: FEBRUARY 24, 2005. APPROVED BY THE PLANNING BOARD 5-1 (P. SHULL OPPOSED, C. LEVY ABSENT). LAST OPPORTUNITY FOR CALL-UP IS MARCH 15, 2005.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.title: LANDMARK ALTERATION CERTIFICATE FOR THE ADDITION OF AN EXTERIOR STAIR TO A PREVIOUSLY APPROVED DESIGN FOR A NEW ONE-CAR GARAGE AT 421 HIGHLAND AVENUE (HIS2005-00032). WIP DATE: MARCH 10, 2005. DENIED BY THE LANDMARKS BOARD (3-1 T. PLESS OPPOSED, R. SALANCE EXCUSED ABSENT). LAST OPPORTUNITY FOR CALL-UP IS MARCH 15, 2005.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.title: FLOODPLAIN DEVELOPMENT PERMIT FOR THE FLATIRONS GOLF COURSE DRIVING RANGE FENCE AT 5706 ARAPAHOE. WIP DATE: MARCH 10, 2005. STAFF APPROVAL. LAST OPPORTUNITY FOR CALL-UP IS MARCH 15, 2005.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.section: 8. MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: ANNUAL APPOINTMENTS TO BOARDS AND COMMISSIONS. – 10:10PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council ratified appointments to various boards and commissions.

agenda_items.section: 8. MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO APPOINT AN EXTERNAL FINANCIAL EXPERT TO THE COUNCIL AUDIT COMMITTEE. – 10:45P.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council appointed Dr. David Frederick to the Council Audit Committee for a 2 year term.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC COMMENT ON MATTERS: - 10:47P.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: NONE

agenda_items.title: FINAL DECISIONS ON MATTERS: - 10:50P.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council took final decisions on ratifying appointments and appointing Dr. David Frederick.

agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The meeting was adjourned at 10:50P.M.
